title: Studying Color and Light: Online Resources
content: What's the best way to teach yourself about color and light? There are a lot of books available, and resources online. Thisblog post by Luiz Celestinoof São Paulo, Brazil gathers together a lot of sources together—not just by me, but also YouTube videos by folks likeTonko House,Nathan Fowkes,Rocket Jump,Stan Prokopenko, andCriswell CinematographyBlog Post:Color and Light do James Gurney - Como estudar este livro?The post is in Portuguese, but most of the videos are in English.
